readiness_scope: Code, Vietnamese prompt/schema and offline contract regressions complete; ready for separately authorized cohort measurement. This is not a measured model-accuracy or BTC-score result.
prompt_sha256_note: Existing API name retained; now hashes VERSION, prompt, Pydantic schema, complete scorer/structured-helper source, imported HUMAN pattern/flags, vocabularies and source/classification contracts.
changes: Vietnamese Pydantic class docstrings and every field description; schema supplied through with_structured_output(Items.model_json_schema(), include_raw=True), forbids unknown keys and non-turn evidence sources. Pydantic validation runs locally after the SDK returns raw output and usage, so output validation errors receive repair/retry rather than invocation-error handling.

Local json_repair and Pydantic revalidation for text, tool_calls, invalid_tool_calls, additional_kwargs.tool_calls/function_call and provider content blocks; no model call on successful repair. Clean raw fallback is not counted as json_repair.

Invocation ValueError/ValidationError for call configuration, network/auth/budget/provider failures receive no helper retry. Provider receives a JSON Schema dictionary, preventing SDK-side Pydantic output validation before raw/usage callbacks. OutputParserException can be recovered locally from llm_output; only known output errors may consume another attempt.

Retry carries complete native and repair validation error strings, without 300/500-character truncation. Detected token truncation, including wrapped exceptions and provider finish metadata, requires a shorter complete response; partial repaired JSON is rejected.
Vietnamese semantic taxonomy uses requested information/candidate, negation/choice/scope/ellipsis/observable context; no regex-based question classifier or metric-driven relabeling added.

Exact current-source quote/offset grounding, source-derived speaker, agent-only questions/claims, no consultant fact usage, no fact_usage without supplied earlier-session context, open values normalized to null.
History whitelist excludes caller-supplied labels/GT; grouping isolates full/baseline configurations and orders calls numerically. Existing caller signatures and trace projection retained.

34 ontology slots retained (30 core + 4 industry); existing channel extension and other sentinel explicitly separate. Instrument and complete sanitized input key the cache, preventing v4 or prior-semantic-contract hits.

v7 separates stock replenishment dates from delivery/receipt/callback/returned-order dates. Prompt requires field-specific evidence including replenishment subject; deterministic projection rejects restock_date without stock-replenishment language or for returned-to-warehouse dates. Eleven synthetic regression cases preserve genuine replenishment and isolate delivery clauses. No scenario IDs, catalogue answers or ground-truth dates added to prompt.

v8 validates every cache hit through the same Items schema as fresh model output; malformed entries are cache misses, never successful empty labels. Recovered-error metadata is validated. Unique temporary files prevent concurrent JSON cache saves from aborting paid evaluation runs. The prompt, schema and label projection rules are unchanged from v7, but the full-source instrument hash changes, so v8 is a separate instrument version.

unresolved_or_limits.detail: Unit tests exercise boundary contracts, validation, repair/retry and callback accounting. They do not show that a real model classifies every authored semantic fixture correctly. Measure/review same replies before claiming an RQR improvement.
BTC generic blocker demo and ellipsis with multiple antecedents remain disclosed interpretation issues; no official gold label invented.
Follow pinned main, not an invented scorer exception; source ambiguities are documented by the policy owner.
Current API supplies previous sessions, not prior turns within the same current session/current customer turn. No hidden context is assumed; semantic use of history still requires model/human review.

Machine checks prove quote existence/source/offsets and selected field rules; they do not prove every value/slot is semantically supported by the quoted text or an earlier utterance. No-history fact usage is blocked deterministically.
Known length exceptions and provider finish metadata are rejected. Missing provider truncation evidence cannot distinguish an accidentally unclosed string from omitted semantic items.
Existing scalar Item.value contract retained: order IDs represented by comma-separated string, while memory ontology remains str_list.

Restock projection requires explicit replenishment language and rejects warehouse-return dates. Language checks do not prove every date is correctly bound when evidence includes several events; prompt requests a separate atomic clause. Human semantic calibration remains required.

Unique atomic temporary files keep every JSON snapshot whole. Separate processes can still overwrite newly cached entries from another writer, causing extra paid cache misses within the unchanged budget cap; use a transactional cache if concurrent cache reuse becomes material.

handoff.next_step: Freeze v8 hashes separately from all earlier snapshots before any new measurement. Run root run_eval.py --relabel on one scenario before a cohort, using the existing budget ledger. v8 has offline validation only; no new model-backed score is claimed.
